mapper.insert: insert into cynexus_appl_market.portfolio_import_asset (id, principal_key, tenant_key, file_name, content_type, byte_size, content_sha256, content_bytes, retention_until) values (#{id}, #{principalKey}, #{tenantKey}, #{fileName}, #{contentType}, #{byteSize}, #{contentSha256}, #{contentBytes}, #{retentionUntil})

insert into cynexus_appl_market.portfolio_import_task (id, principal_key, tenant_key, asset_id, status, version, attempt_count, idempotency_key) values (#{id}, #{principalKey}, #{tenantKey}, #{assetId}, #{status}, #{version}, #{attemptCount}, #{idempotencyKey})
